page.overview:
What is Mega Clefable?

Clefable resembles a larger Clefairy, with bigger ears and tail, larger wings, and no claws on its hands.

Clefable is shyer than Clefairy. Due to its highly sensitive hearing, a Clefable will avoid noisy areas and prefers dwelling in secluded mountains. On moonlit nights, groups of Clefable can rarely be seen walking towards secluded, deserted lakes; they are said to gaze at the moon in longing to return home, straining their ears to hear the voices of their brethren on its surface. It is said seeing a pair of them is a sign of a happy marriage.

A Clefable can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away, due to its acute hearing.

Clefable evolves from Clefairy if it touches a Moon Stone and is the final evolution of Cleffa. Clefable can Mega Evolve into Mega Clefable using its Clefablite.
